notes: «وقد روى سلم بن زرير عن عبد الرحمن بن طرفة نحو حديث أبي الأشهب» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group
al-Tirmidhi's remarks and the note on Ibn Mahdi are commentary, not routes; «نحوه» is wording
the chain stops at أبي الأشهب as written; no Companion is named in this text
